articles.title: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
articles.description: Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window. articles.title: This light-powered AI can spot deepfakes with nearly 98% accuracy

Its speed, low energy demands, and resistance to attacks could make it a powerful tool for screening the growing flood of AI-generated video.
